commit_message:
Dedup identity and HashableMixin: one definition each, re-exported (#143)

identity (caching, paths, tools) and identity_func (sources) are now
dol.util.identity_func, which keeps the documented doctests; caching's
HashableMixin is util's, and mixins.HashableMixin extends it with its
identity equality. All old names still import from their modules.

Part of #70

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
